ns2:course.label: Italian Diction
ns2:course.description: Phonetics applied to Italian song literature; class and individual clinical analysis and practice. To be taken with MUS 181. Prerequisite: Freshman standing in voice or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Freshman standing in voice or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Voice or Lyric Theatre major(s). Restricted to BMA: Lyric Theatre - UIUC, BMUS:Voice -UIUC, or BME:Mus Ed:Choral Music-UIUC.
